evals.prompt: Migrate our REST API from v1 to v2. v1 uses /api/v1/users with custom auth headers. v2 uses /api/v2/users with OAuth2 Bearer tokens. We have 47 call sites across 12 files. What's the safest pattern?
evals.expected_output: The skill must run the 5 go/no-go gate questions first. If all pass, produce a caller inventory, pick a migration pattern (Feature Flag, Strangler Fig, Adapter, or Big Bang) with justification, and produce a phased cut-over plan with rollback triggers.

assertions.name: five_gates_present
assertions.description: Response asks the 5 go/no-go gate questions (freeze changes, caller inventory, new target proven, rollback <5min, cost comparison)

assertions.name: caller_inventory_present
assertions.description: Response produces an inventory of call sites with columns: Symbol, Caller Count, Tested?, Active?, Priority

assertions.name: pattern_justification_present
assertions.description: Response picks one migration pattern and justifies why (not just lists all 4)

assertions.name: rollback_plan_present
assertions.description: Response includes explicit rollback triggers and timing (<5 min)

assertions.name: big_bang_banned_at_scale
assertions.description: Response does NOT recommend Big Bang for 47 call sites across 12 files

evals.prompt: Upgrade PostgreSQL from 13 to 16 in production. The database is 800GB with 99.9% uptime SLA.
evals.expected_output: The skill must flag Big Bang as banned for this scale, recommend a pattern with minimal downtime (likely Feature Flag or blue-green), and include a decommission timeline.

assertions.name: big_bang_rejected
assertions.description: Response explicitly rejects Big Bang for an 800GB production database

assertions.name: uptime_sla_respected
assertions.description: Response respects the 99.9% uptime SLA and does not propose scheduled downtime without explicit user approval

assertions.name: rollback_plan_present
assertions.description: Response includes a rollback plan with timing

assertions.name: decommission_window_present
assertions.description: Response mentions a decommission window (7d/24h/30d standard)

evals.prompt: Build a new payment gateway module that supports Stripe and PayPal. Start from scratch with TDD.
evals.expected_output: This is greenfield development with no legacy target. The skill should NOT trigger — it should redirect to /feature-dev or /tdd.

assertions.name: no_migration_procedure
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the migration procedure (gates → inventory → pattern → scaffold → cut-over → decommission)

assertions.name: redirect_to_feature_dev
assertions.description: Response redirects to /feature-dev or /tdd, or explains this is not a migration
